wholePhysicalScope: The native building outline establishes the 23.6-metre Hallituskatu frontage, shallow central projection and 45-metre historical depth. The modern west extension is described separately in the city inventory.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the entrance arcade, metal hip roofs and historic stagehouse.
limitations: Standing historic theatre and stagehouse. The modern 1974 theatre annex and interiors are outside scope.
Historic front details follow the primary photo. Rear fenestration, exact roof junctions and small ornamental patterns are representative.
